entries.text: Citus tuning files now drive table placement. `distribution` hash-distributes a table on its first column, `reference: true` creates a reference table and `columnar: true` converts it to the `citus_columnar` access method; each is read back from `pg_dist_partition` or `pg_am` before it is recorded as applied. The adapter claims `PARTITIONING`, `CLUSTERING`, `SORTING` and `DISTRIBUTION`. CLUSTER is verified on every shard through `run_command_on_shards` and recorded as not applied on columnar tables and on partitioned distributed tables. A tuning-file entry takes precedence over `--citus-distribution-column`. The new `reference` and `columnar` table flags are rejected on any other platform. A TPC-H profile is at `examples/tunings/citus/tpch_tuned.yaml`.
